mccf.config.disable_thinking_warning_bod: Turning this on makes translations faster and cheaper (fewer tokens spent on internal reasoning before the actual answer). However, not every model supports being forced out of thinking mode -- some newer model versions may reject the request entirely if this is enabled, which would break translation for that provider. If translations stop working after turning this on, try turning it back off first.
mccf.config.endpoint_reset: Endpoint reset (will use default on save).
mccf.config.mock_warning: Mock is a placeholder — it does NOT call any real translation API.
mccf.config.mock_warning_title: Are you sure you want to use Mock Provider?
mccf.config.mock_warning_body: Mock is a debugging placeholder that does not call any real translation API. All chat messages will be passed through as-is without any translation. Please use a real Provider (e.g., OpenAI, DeepL) for production.
mccf.config.mock_warning_persistent: Mock is for debugging only: selecting this Provider means no messages will actually be translated — all chat passes through as original text. Do not use in production.
